items.evidence: Everything we do depends on safely executing our business plans and operating to high standards of HSE stewardship. We view this as our fundamental license to operate.
As an E&P company, strong operational performance is essential for delivering on our commitments to stockholders.
The Financial metrics in our compensation programs strongly align with our returns-focused strategy and are core to delivering our value proposition
Strategic and ESG Milestones represent specific actions that are critical to implementing our strategy and aligning our workforce.
TSR is the best overall indicator of our success.
We target top-quartile performance relative to our peers for Total Recordable Rate and absolute continuous improvement for Process Safety Events.
We include relative Total Recordable Rate and absolute Process Safety Events in our compensation metrics to reinforce our commitment
Therefore, we set an annual Production target, and we measure the achievement of production results against the approved target.
Our operational compensation metrics include absolute targets for Production, Capital, Operating and Overhead Costs, and Operational Milestones.
Our Operational Milestones are intended to drive a focus on key actions or decisions that support delivery of our plan.
For VCIP, our Financial compensation measure includes Adjusted ROCE both on an absolute basis, as well as relative to peers.
Our Strategic milestones included successfully integrating Concho and demonstrating an annual run rate of #million of sustainable cost
demonstrating progress toward our Paris-aligned climate risk framework by executing approved marginal abatement cost curve projects
achieving top quartile ESG performance on MSCI, ISS, ESG, Bloomberg ESG and DJSI rating frameworks relative to peers.
In addition, we included a DE&I milestone to increase internal and external transparency of DE&I metrics.
comprised of a relative TSR metric and a relative Financial metric
For PSP, our Financial compensation measure includes Adjusted ROCE, and for PSPs commencing prior to #Adjusted CROCE, relative to peers.
We include Adjusted ROCE in both our VCIP and PSP to ensure that we maintain financial discipline and balance short- and long-term performance.
the HRCC removed Adjusted CROCE to simplify the performance metrics for PSP and strengthen the correlation
